---
title: "Read and save both sets of ICD10 and COD code lists"
format: html
---

Get the various causes of death files that we need to match against the causes in the database. 

The death data sometimes uses two-digit and sometimes 4-digit values. We'll need to work on the nesting. 




## List from NCHS 

This is the official cause of death data from CDC via the NCHS: <https://ftp.cdc.gov/pub/Health_Statistics/NCHS/Publications/ICD10/>

(Downloaded the xlsx files. )

I'm just using the 2023 version. 


```{r}
#| include: false

suppressMessages(library(tidyverse))
library(readxl)
library(here)
i_am("cause-of-death-files.qmd")




```

```{r}

cdc_death_codes <- 
  read_excel("cod-codes/allvalid2023-detailed-titles-headings.xlsx", skip=5) |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  mutate (clean_code = str_remove_all (code, "\\.")) |> 
  select ( code=clean_code, nchs_desc = icd_title, orig_code = code)




```

```{r}
#| eval: false


saveRDS(cdc_death_codes, "ncha_cod_codes.RdS")


```


## List from CMS

Downloaded the 2025 files from https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coding-billing/icd-10-codes

The one that has the "order files" for diagnosis codes is the one that's used here -- it is the one that has the header rows that group things in the order thay show up in the instructions. It's useful because even though they don't always have a match code they may have a match group that will be good enough for us. 


```{r}


icd10_codes <- 
read_fwf ( here( "cod-codes/icd10OrderFiles2025_0/icd10cm_order_2025.txt"), 
   fwf_cols(row_order = c(1,5), 
        code = c(7,13), 
        header = c(15, 15) , 
        short_desc = c( 17, 76), 
        long_desc = c(78, NA) 
   ), 
   col_types = cols("i", "c", "i", "c", "c" )
 )  |> 
 mutate ( headline = if_else ( header == 0, short_desc, NA_character_) ,
          master_code = if_else ( header==0, code, NA_character_ ) 
 ) |> 
 fill ( c( headline, master_code), .direction="down") |> 
 select ( row_order, code, icd_desc = short_desc, master_code, master_desc = headline) 




```

```{r}
#| eval: false

saveRDS(icd10_codes , "cms_icd10.RDS")


```
